description: LOLA RDR laser-altimeter shots (simple topography: longitude, latitude, radius minus 1,737.4 km) in one box per terrain tier, for the alignment check of every package source (RW-60c, navigator N32, D-R105). Queried from the PDS Geosciences Node ODE Granular Data System; a query returns the same bytes every time, so each extract is pinned by its query and sha256. Fetch with: python pipeline/lola_tracks.py

license.statement: PDS Geosciences Node: "Data sets archived in the PDS are in the public domain."
